category.reason: There is only one bar between 06:00 and 12:00; the target is the local position at the top of that orange bar.

instruction.en: Select the top of the bar chart between 06:00 and 12:00
instruction.zh: 选中06:00与12:00之间柱子的顶端。

reference.patch: Added instruction.zh by translating the original English instruction. The original groundTruth covered the correct orange bar top between 06:00 and 12:00, but its 69-by-78-pixel tolerance region also accepted surrounding space above and to either side of the bar. Tightened groundTruth from [929.0, 508.0, 1007.0, 439.0] to [949.0, 496.0, 986.0, 459.0] in [top, right, bottom, left] pixel coordinates, reducing the accepted region to 37 by 37 pixels around that bar top for more precise localization. This changes the accepted positional tolerance without selecting a different bar. Updated category.reason to identify the bar as orange; the Fine-grained Manipulation category and bilingual instructions were retained.
